'''Strell House''' was a place at the [[Promenade]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] named after charity worker [[Daegin Strell]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Rylee Dray]] and [[Destris Veran]] picked it as the location for their new cult led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] after splitting from a rival [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]] led by Lord [[Paladius]].<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Darth Nox|Sith Inquisitor]]|The Big Show|[[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Strell House appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor's class missions on Nar Shaddaa.
